name: michael
description: Semantic token map. Channels: level (ink/strong/fg/muted/faint) x weight (regular/bold) x style (none/italic) x overlay (bgFill/outline/inverse/underline).
rules: Lightness = importance. Bold = binding. Italic = kind (metadata, not code). Underline = diagnostics ONLY, never decorative.
No two token states sharing a context may share the same (level, weight, style) triple.
v2 lesson: moving numbers to strong+bold crowded strong (func-def/func-call/decorator) and dropped dark keyword/type scores — reverted. fg+bold collision with variables is the lesser evil.

diffChanged.note: direction carried by gutter signs (+/-), fills are secondary

notes: Bracket-pair nesting = depth-mapped lightness cycling faint -> fg -> strong, replacing hue cycling.
Search-other uses outline instead of fill: fill tiers would locally break text contrast; outline changes nothing behind glyphs.
